angularDiameterSource: Stellar radius 0.4445 ± 0.0148 solar radii from Benneke et al. (2019, ApJL 887, L14; arXiv:1909.04642), Table 1. It is a radius from stellar characterisation, not an interferometric diameter; the angular diameter in the record is that radius at the Gaia distance: 0.109 mas.
distanceSource: Gaia EDR3 parallax 26.2469 +/- 0.0266 mas via SIMBAD (2020yCat.1350....0G): 1000/26.2469 = 38.10 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius: 0.4445 +/- 0.0148 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius, from Benneke et al. (2019, ApJL 887, L14; arXiv:1909.04642), Table 1. GM from the stellar mass there, 0.4951 +/- 0.0043 solar masses (Cloutier et al. 2019), times the JPL solar GM 132712440041.93938 km^3/s^2. presentationUp: no spin axis is measured, so the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Effective temperature 3457 ± 39 K from Sarkis et al. 2018 (AJ 155, 257; https://arxiv.org/abs/1805.00830), Table 2, which adopts it from Benneke et al. 2017.
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the astronomy record's GM and radius (physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-18 (pscomppars): spectral type M2.5 V, from Benneke et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017ApJ...834..187B/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-18 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.09 dex, from Montet et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...809...25M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-18 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.59688, from Benneke et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019ApJ...887L..14B/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-18 (pscomppars): rotation period 38.6 d, from Cloutier et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...608A..35C/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, K2-18: projected rotation speed 2.51 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2024A&A...687A.205M)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray; no picture of the photosphere is cast.
